text:
alex_sales: Hey team — prepping a POC for NovaGov (enterprise). They asked for confirmation on SSO + SCIM + RBAC scope and pricing impact. Quick sync?

jess_eng: thx. quick list of asks from buyer: 1) SAML SSO (IdP-initiated + SP-initiated), assertion audience check, 2) SCIM provisioning with bulk delta for 200k users, 3) RBAC mapping to SCIM groups, 4) domain verification for tenant locking, 5) pricing for Dedicated vs Hosted for steady 400rps inference, and 6) audit log retention SLA.

amend: also they mentioned 3rd-party IdP (Ping) and will want Okta later.

mira_sec: security quick notes — we support SAML2.0 with SHA256, ACS URL validation, and signed assertions. Domain ownership: we require DNS TXT verification for hosted tenants unless on Dedicated with customer-managed certs.

carlo_se: for SCIM: we support RFC7644 endpoints, bulk PATCH with 1000-user batches. For 200k initial sync suggest using our SCIM bulk helper + backoff. Example config snippet:```PATCH /scim/v2/Users``````{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:PatchOp"], "Operations": [...]} ```

jess_eng: RBAC mapping — we can map SCIM groups -> Redwood roles via the provisioning profile. Roles can be custom per-customer (admin, read-only, developer). Group-to-role sync runs every 5m by default, configurable.

alex_sales: kop — pricing/team asked what delta is when they want SCIM sync every 1m and 5x audit retention.

sam_billing: pricing callouts: Hosted cheaper at low qps, Dedicated recommended for sustained 400rps — estimate: hosted ~ $Xk/month (usage-based) vs Dedicated base $Yk/month + usage. SCIM heavy syncs and high retention bump infra surcharge. Need SKU ask to get exact numbers.

mira_sec: also flag: for enterprise legal they'll ask about account separation. On Hosted we provide tenant isolation but not full physical isolation unless Dedicated. If they need dedicated KMS/HSM bring-up, that's Dedicated + SOC2 add-on.

carlo_se: POC runbook suggestion: 1) enable test SAML connector (send metadata from Ping), 2) run SCIM bulk import to staging with our helper, 3) set up a role mapping file and smoke RBAC, 4) run load test at 400rps for 24h. I can run steps 2+4 with infra team.

alex_sales: thanks. action items: @carlo_se own SCIM + load; @jess_eng confirm SAML assertion timeouts + exact audience check behavior; @mira_sec provide a short security summary for the questionnaire; @sam_billing provide preliminary dedicated/base numbers.

jess_eng: SAML details: we accept assertions with Conditions NotBefore/NotOnOrAfter validated within clock skew 120s. Audience must match SP EntityID or ACS target. We also support encrypted assertions on request.

mira_sec: security summary (short): we support signed assertions (RSA-SHA256), ACS/EntityID validation, optional encrypted assertions, audit logs pushed to customer S3 for Dedicated, retention up to 365d (configurable), and SCIM over HTTPS with mutual TLS available for Dedicated.

sam_billing: I'll put a preliminary quote in the thread by EOD — need to confirm expected token usage (avg tokens per request) and whether they want reserved capacity vs burst.

alex_sales: client Q: will SSO downtime affect inference routing? specifically if SAML IdP is unavailable can users still call API for previously provisioned service accounts?

jess_eng: yes — service accounts (API keys) are independent. SAML only affects web console login and SCIM provisioning flows. We recommend OAuth service accounts for automation.

carlo_se: small gotcha: when group-to-role sync runs, if a group is removed we soft-unmap for 24h before revoking tokens to avoid accidental lockouts. Note this behavior in runbook.

amend: cc'ing deploy-bot for staging provisioning.

deploy-bot: [info] created staging-tenant `novagov-poc` in us-west-2, scim-endpoint=https://poc.redwood.ai/scim/novagov, service-account created (********).

alex_sales: perfect. next steps: carlo to run initial SCIM import Tue, jess to confirm SAML edge-cases Wed, mira to draft questionnaire answers Thu, sam to post quote Thu EOD. I'll loop in legal once we have draft questionnaire.

carlo_se: ack — will kick off import Tue morning. Will log results to the runbook.

mira_sec: will draft the security answers and attach a one-pager on domain verification options.

sam_billing: noted — need estimated #tokens/request from sales to finalize numbers; alex can you get that?

alex_sales: yup, asking customer now. will update here. :thumbsup:

carlo_se: one more: for SCIM throttling, if they do delta every 1m we'll recommend rate-limiter config and backoff; default throttle is 100 req/min per tenant on Hosted.

alex_sales: great call. thanks everyone — will update after customer reply.
